text: dsh-ai-memory 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件，基于 Rust 与 SQLite 按项目保存工作、情景和档案记忆，并通过工具和系统提示词接入 Harness。它提供记忆写入、混合检索、删除、固定保留、显式整理及压缩能力，也可在每轮提示词中自动预取符合 token 预算的相关记忆。核心逻辑使用 Rust crate，插件优先连接 napi 原生模块并在缺少时回退到 CLI。适合需要跨轮保留项目背景、减少重复说明并控制上下文长度的 DSH 用户；不需要 API 密钥，数据保存在本地 SQLite 数据库。

dsh-ai-memory adds local project memory to DeepSeek Harness with Rust and SQLite. Tools save, recall, delete, pin, consolidate, and compact notes. Automatic prefetch adds relevant memories to the prompt within a token budget. It uses a native addon or the ai-memory CLI. No API key is needed.
我想让 DSH 在不同轮次之间记住每个项目的重要信息。
能不能把工作笔记和长期档案分开保存，再按问题找回来？
我希望聊天变长时只把相关记忆放进提示词，并限制 token 数。
想在本地保存 agent 记忆，不把内容交给外部模型服务。
怎样让记忆按项目隔离，避免不同项目互相召回？
I want my DSH agent to keep useful notes between turns for each project.
Can I retrieve relevant memories and fit them into a fixed prompt token budget?
dsh-ai-memory 的功能「记忆写入」：用户调用 memory_remember 提交文本，可选择 working、episodic 或 profile 层级，插件将其保存到当前项目的记忆库。
dsh-ai-memory 的功能「混合召回」：调用 memory_recall 并提供查询文本，可按时间、关键词和向量相关性查找当前项目的记忆。
dsh-ai-memory 的功能「预算化上下文预取」：启用预取后，插件从最近用户消息提取查询，并将命中记忆按 tokenBudget 加入 DSH 系统提示词。
dsh-ai-memory 的功能「管理与整理记忆」：工具支持按 ID 删除或固定记忆，也可显式执行策略整理和工作笔记压缩；整理和压缩不会自动运行。
我想手动整理旧笔记，把工作记忆折叠成更精简的内容。
dsh-ai-memory 提供工具 not_a_tool

Local **Rust + SQLite** memory for agent harnesses: per-project working / episodic / profile notes, and a **token-budgeted** pack for the next model call (not the full transcript). Optional DeepSeek Harness plugin.

It does **not** stuff a 1M-token transcript into the prompt, run consolidate in the background, or talk to an LLM.

dsh-ai-memory README · Install into DeepSeek Harness：Copy-paste guide (pin commit, `allowBuilds`, what you should see):

- English: [docs/INSTALL_DSH.md](docs/INSTALL_DSH.md)
- 中文: [docs/INSTALL_DSH.zh-CN.md](docs/INSTALL_DSH.zh-CN.md)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zzjzzb/ai-memory#<commit>
```

Get `<commit>` with `git ls-remote https://github.com/zzjzzb/ai-memory.git refs/heads/main` (left column). After add: `dsh --profile web --dump-config` must show `# == dsh-ai-memory`.

dsh-ai-memory README · Scenario → call → get：```bash
cargo test
cargo run --example harness_loop_sim
cargo run --bin ai-memory -- --in-memory memory_remember '{"text":"hi","tier":"profile"}'
```

`open()` applies WAL and other SQLite defaults. Inject a real [`Embedder`](src/embedder.rs) when you have one; default `HashEmbedder` is offline. Optional `--features sqlite-vec`.

dsh-ai-memory README · Do / don't：| Do | Don't |
|----|--------|
| Persist turns with `remember_turn` | Dump the full transcript into the model |
| `prefetch_within_budget(query, TokenBudget { max_tokens })` | Expect 1M tokens to fit in one prompt |
| `pin` must-keep facts | Auto-consolidate or auto-compact |
| Call `compact_working` / `consolidate` when you mean to | Add an LLM client in this crate |

Isolation is `project_id`. Two sessions on one file do not leak recall.

dsh-ai-memory README · DeepSeek Harness (showcase)：The intended **consumer / showcase** is [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a thin Cordis `apply(ctx)` plugin over **this Rust crate** (SQLite stays here; we do not rewrite memory in JS, and we do not pitch auto-LLM extraction).
